selection_rule: Preselect distinct C-file revisions whose titles suggest little-endian typed writes, conversions, or sparse type warnings likely to exercise compound field updates or 64-bit array slots. Keep all targets and the scope control fixed regardless of raw checker output or later source review. Classify a zero-site output as out of scope rather than a clean commit.
